description: Per-person discrete-time survival negative log-likelihood for packed survival-credit and event-interval flags, following Gensheimer & Narasimhan (2019), Implementation Eqs. 9-13. Probability inputs use epsilon-clipped likelihood factors as in the official PyTorch loss (nnet_survival_pytorch.py:380-423); batch reduction is none, mean, or sum.

examples.title: Train a discrete-time survival model

name: Nnet-Survival discrete-time loss

parameters.additional parameters: from_logits is the only accepted keyword in **params; unsupported keys raise ValueError
parameters.from_logits: bool that applies sigmoid to logits and uses stable log-likelihood terms (default False)
parameters.ignore_index: must be None because packed survival and event flags do not support ignored intervals
parameters.logits_or_prediction: floating-point tensor shaped [B,T]; conditional survival probabilities in [0,1] by default or logits when from_logits=True
parameters.reduction: none returns a negative log-likelihood per person, mean averages people, or sum totals people (default mean)
parameters.targets: floating-point binary tensor shaped [B,2T], packed as T survival-credit flags followed by T event-interval flags
